definitions.explanation: Happening without deliberate effort or external force; arising as a natural consequence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ければ→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧、おのずと⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you keep practicing, you'll naturally improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}てば→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧、おのずと⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}えてくる→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you give it time, the answer will naturally become clear.

examples.japanese: おのずと⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こぼれた→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧。

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {自|おの}ずと. The kanji {自|おの} emphasizes "self" or "by itself."

ALTERNATIVE FORMS:
- ⟦おのずから→おのずから：noentry⟧ - slightly more formal/literary variant
- {自|おの}ずと - kanji spelling

USAGE:
Describes events or outcomes that occur without forcing:
- おのずと⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (results will come naturally)
- おのずと⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (will naturally understand)
- おのずと⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are natural limits)
Implies a natural, organic process rather than forced or artificial one. Often suggests that patience or proper conditions will lead to a natural outcome.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ - naturally (more common in casual speech)
- ⟦ひとりでに→ひとりでに：noentry⟧ - by itself, automatically
- ⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧ - before one knows it
